Upper West Side buildings over the $1 million line

69 condos and 13 co-ops in Manhattan on the FY2027 roll.

Upper West Side (Manhattan) has 69 condominiums (with 1,619 units valued at $1 million or more) and 13 co-ops averaging $1 million or more per apartment on the FY2027 Department of Finance roll.
